metrics_are_not_bug_counts: Different backgrounds can be intentional selection, input, grid options, tab states, frame boundaries or host-owned backgrounds. Findings require source/context review.

findings.cause: Fill surface first; then paint text with complete body/info/success/warning/error role including canvas background; no local surface override.
Current path body and status role styles carry canvas BG onto surface, only glyph cells recolored.
Styles::role/control is raw foreground+background; host Paragraph areas inside surface panels use body/canvas BG. Go example TextView paths explicitly bind surface BG.
Direct helpers set field/list styles but leave standalone box/label default black; Apply with Panel surface resolves the observed case.

findings.cause: Badge/chip default body BG forms a glyph-length patch; simple Grid UseSurface=false is documented canvas styling; inactive tabs paint full segments; list selected highlight is glyph-length. Do not classify all differences as defects.
